description: THRU path from IBM's public IEEE 802.3 100 Gb/s experimental backplane test-fixture data set
measured_or_simulated: publisher describes the files as experimental test-fixture S-parameters; acquisition method is not stated in the supplied header
touchstone_matrix_order: row-major full matrix (S11 S12 ... S14, S21 ... S44)
port_map_basis: the two dominant forward paths are S21 and S43; this assignment produces the physically causal differential THRU response
project_role: public lossy reference channel for integration, RL training and comparison
limitations: This data set was contributed to an IEEE 802.3 backplane study, not a PCI-SIG PCIe compliance program.
It is suitable for exercising and benchmarking the PCIe Gen-2 equalizer at 2.5 GHz Nyquist, but must not be called a certified PCIe channel.
The publisher supplies the model as-is for modeling purposes with no warranties or guarantees; the original disclaimer remains in the S4P header.
